sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art game source sheet for AuraGo. Generate ONE square PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no logos. EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 complete isolated objects in equally sized invisible cells, generous transparent gutters, absolutely nothing overlaps cells. Orthographic SIDE VIEW, flat front elevations, not isometric, roof fronts visible only as facade shapes. Rich crisp pixel art at roughly 128px per building, dark navy outlines, warm stone, brick, emerald, sapphire, terracotta and gold; coherent scale, consistent top-left light. Each whole object must be uncut and large enough to slice into modular building pieces afterward. Objects in exact row-major order: ROW 1: small timber cottage with triangular red roof (square silhouette); tall four-storey townhouse with flat roof (rectangular solid facade); stone shop with awning (square); broad brick industrial workshop with flat roof (4:3). ROW 2: broad castle gatehouse with connected solid stone ramparts (4:3); rectangular stone watchtower with flat battlement (1:2); wooden barn with broad red roof (square); rectangular glass greenhouse (3:2). ROW 3: double garage with flat blue roof (3:2); straight wooden footbridge horizontal with railings (4:1); wooden fence section (square); stone fence post (square). ROW 4: well with canopy (square); wooden signpost without text (square); tall streetlamp (1:2); circular stone fountain seen from side with water basin (square). Buildings should be filled architectural elevations, no floating roof pieces. Never draw a background ground plane or cast shadows. Preserve transparent space surrounding each complete asset. Strong readable game silhouettes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original pixel-art game asset PNG, square, REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Exact 4 columns x 4 rows of 16 complete separated objects with at least 20 pixels outer margin and gutters. Camera strictly 90 degrees TOP DOWN from directly overhead, NOT isometric, no visible front facades, no perspective foreshortening. Bright readable pixel art, dark navy outlines, terracotta red and sapphire blue roofs, cream masonry, green vegetation, warm wood matching an arcade/fantasy world. Buildings are full overhead roof-and-footprint views, rectangular filled footprints suitable for splitting into 64px modular roof tiles. No text, no labels, no grids, no background, no shadows. Row-major order: ROW1 square red-roof timber cottage; long rectangular blue-roof townhouse with four roof sections; square blue-roof shop with a striped awning on south edge; wide rectangular flat-roof brick industrial workshop with vents. ROW2 wide rectangular gray castle gatehouse and parapets with passage center; rectangular narrow stone watchtower from overhead with battlements; square red-roof wooden barn; rectangular glass greenhouse with visible beds. ROW3 broad double garage blue roof; horizontal wooden footbridge viewed overhead with parallel railings; short wooden fence horizontal; square stone fence post. ROW4 square well with timber canopy overhead; wooden signpost top view; streetlamp top view with narrow arm; round stone fountain from overhead with concentric turquoise water basins. Keep every object entirely inside its own cell. NO clipping, no ground islands, no angled side-view buildings. Each isolated object centered, dimensions vary naturally but use clean boundaries.

Use case: stylized-concept. One square original PIXEL ART sprite source PNG for a game, genuinely transparent alpha background. EXACTLY FIVE columns and TEN rows, 50 separate sprites, aligned to equal invisible cells, at least 10px transparent gutters on all sides and outside sheet. No grid, no captions, no text, no logos, no shadows. All vehicles ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT. Coherent dark-navy pixel outlines, sapphire blue, emerald military green, silver, warm gold accents, colorful readable arcade vehicles. Do not overlap cells. Within each row animation vehicle chassis stays identical in position and size, wheels/rotors/tracks visibly change phases. Each row left-to-right five consecutive animation frames except row 8 which has five different large vehicles. Row 1: blue compact car, five rotating wheel poses. Row 2: green jeep, five rotating wheel poses. Row 3: red motorcycle without rider, five wheel poses. Row 4: yellow farm tractor, five rotating wheel poses. Row 5: olive tank, five visibly cycling treads poses, turret right. Row 6: blue helicopter, five distinct main-rotor phases with exactly same body, rotor visibly horizontal/diagonal/shortened across frames. Row 7: silver small propeller airplane, five spinning propeller phases, nose right. Row 8: large red cargo truck with trailer; yellow city bus; blue cargo aircraft; orange crane truck; white ambulance with red stripe. Row 9: standalone five-phase spinning four-blade metallic aircraft propeller, right-facing side-view hub, no vehicle. Row 10: standalone chunky rubber wheel with gold hub, five distinctly rotated spoke phases. Keep every whole vehicle uncut. Sideways profiles should remain wide in cells. Each row is 5 sprites, exactly 10 rows.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original pixel-art vehicle animation sprite source sheet, REAL transparent alpha PNG. 5 columns, 10 rows: exactly 50 isolated sprites, uniform invisible cells, generous transparent gutters and full outer margin. Camera DIRECT OVERHEAD TOP DOWN, all vehicles point UP (north), no side profiles, no isometric perspective. Coherent detailed arcade pixel art dark navy outlines, blue/silver civilian vehicles, green military, warm yellow/orange accents. No text, logos, grid lines, backgrounds, shadow planes, people. Left to right per row are five actual motion phases with same vehicle size and anchor: row1 blue compact car, subtly changing wheel positions; row2 olive jeep, moving wheels; row3 red motorcycle viewed directly from overhead; row4 yellow tractor, visible changing tire treads; row5 olive tank, visible cycling tracks with gun pointing up; row6 blue helicopter, five genuinely different rotor orientations around SAME hub with same body; row7 silver small propeller plane pointing up, five propeller rotation phases; row8 DIFFERENT large vehicles pointing up: red semi truck with trailer, yellow bus, large blue cargo aircraft, orange crane truck, white ambulance with red stripe; row9 standalone five-phase spinning metallic four-blade aircraft rotor from directly overhead, consistent hub center; row10 five frames of cyan engine exhaust plume, narrow bright core growing/dissipating below nozzle, transparent surrounding. Uniform 5 by 10 layout. Each object complete with ample alpha padding.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a complete original pixel-art nature game sprite sheet on a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. EXACT 10 columns by 10 rows, 100 separate objects, one centered sprite in each invisible cell with transparent padding. Orthographic SIDE VIEW suitable for jump-and-run games, all stand on the same baseline within cells. Crisp rich pixel art, dark navy outline, emerald and olive foliage, brown timber, slate rocks, warm floral accents, matching fantasy arcade assets. No labels, text, grid, background color, landscape, floor plane, cast shadows or overlapping sprites. Each row contains TEN distinct variations in this exact order: row1 trees (oak, pine, birch, willow, palm, dead tree, autumn maple, fruit tree, fir, ancient oak); row2 bushes (leafy, berry, thorn, fern, hedge, flowering, dry, mossy, tall reeds, bramble); row3 grasses and reeds of ten silhouettes; row4 ten colorful flower clumps; row5 ten mushrooms including red, brown, white, violet, blue glowing types; row6 ten isolated rock/boulder/crystal piles; row7 ten woodland props (stump, hollow log, branch, roots, acorn, pinecone, leaf pile, driftwood, broken trunk, vines); row8 ten small isolated water features (pond lip, waterfall segment, splash, icicle, lily pad side, water grass, stream ripple side, coral, shell, seaweed); row9 desert nature (cactus tall, cactus round, cactus branching, aloe, dry shrub, sandstone, dune grass, tumbleweed, agave, bones); row10 snowy nature (snowy pine, snowy bush, icy rock, icicle cluster, snowy stump, frozen grass, snow mound, ice crystal, snowy branch, frozen reeds). Strong readable distinct silhouettes. Keep the first and last row fully inside the image margin.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a game NATURE sprite sheet, original crisp pixel art on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. EXACTLY 10 columns x 10 rows, 100 separate objects. Each object occupies only 70 percent of its invisible cell so there are LARGE TRANSPARENT GUTTERS between all sprites and a 30px OUTER MARGIN. No touching, no cut-off assets. Camera TOP DOWN, as seen from directly overhead in a 2D adventure map. Dense green tree canopies with trunks concealed, round shrubs and rock footprints, overhead plants. Dark navy outlines, emerald/olive greens, sapphire water, warm flowers, slate and brown, fantasy arcade palette. No isometric trees, no front elevations. No numbers, text, grid, background scene, drop shadows. Ten objects per row: row1 overhead canopies of oak, pine, birch, willow, palm, dead tree, autumn maple, fruit tree, fir, ancient oak; row2 ten bushes including berries, thorns, fern, hedge, flowers, dry shrub, moss, reeds, bramble; row3 ten grasses/ferns/reeds viewed from above; row4 ten differently colored flower patches; row5 ten mushroom clusters viewed from above including red brown white violet glowing blue; row6 ten rocks, boulders, slate and crystals from above; row7 stump with rings, hollow log, branch, root patch, acorn, pinecone, leaf pile, driftwood, broken trunk, vines all overhead; row8 overhead pond, stream bend, water ripple, icy puddle, lily pad, reeds in water, stepping stones, coral, shells, seaweed; row9 tall cactus crown, round cactus, branched cactus, aloe, dry shrub, sandstone, dune grass, tumbleweed, agave, bones; row10 snow-covered pine canopy, snowy bush, icy rock, icicle cluster, snowy stump, frozen grass, snow mound, ice crystal, snowy branch, frozen reeds. Every sprite fully contained and isolated.

Use case: stylized-concept. A professional original PIXEL ART animation source sheet with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. EXACT TEN COLUMNS by TEN ROWS of 100 isolated animation frames. Invisible uniform cells, each character at most 65 percent of cell size, wide transparent gutters and outer margin. SIDE VIEW: every robot faces RIGHT. Five coherent original robot designs, each occupies exactly TWO rows (20 frames). Robot1 rows1-2: slim silver service humanoid with blue visor. Robot2 rows3-4: bulky orange armored biped combat mech. Robot3 rows5-6: green four-legged spider maintenance drone. Robot4 rows7-8: silver blue quadcopter with FOUR propellers and central camera. Robot5 rows9-10: spherical violet hovering security drone with single cyan eye and small thrusters. For each robot the first row has 4 distinct IDLE poses then 6 actual locomotion poses (walking legs on bipeds, cycling spider legs, changing quadcopter rotor orientation, hover drone fins/thrust). Its second row has 4 ATTACK poses with arm/claw/laser-emitter movement, 2 recoiling HIT poses with sparks, then 4 DESTRUCTION poses from damaged to collapsed to broken parts and a small nonempty scrap pile. Preserve size, body identity, baseline and anchor throughout, real limb movement not mere translation. Crisp dark-navy outlines, metallic slate/silver, sapphire blue, orange/gold, emerald green and violet, strong highlights matching fantasy arcade game art. No backgrounds, floor shadows, labels, text, grid lines, numbered cells, humans, recognizable franchise characters. Keep all 100 frames entirely inside separate cells. Death last frame contains visible debris, never empty.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original pixel-art robot and drone TOP DOWN animation source sheet, REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. Exactly 10 columns and 10 rows = 100 isolated frames. Every frame inside uniform invisible cells, small 60%-cell character scale, at least 12px clear gutters, 24px outer margin. No grid, labels, text, backgrounds, shadows, weapons firing out of cells. Five character designs each has TWO ROWS, 20 frames, all in top-down game perspective: silver service humanoid blue visor; bulky orange armored biped mech; green four-legged spider maintenance drone; silver/blue quadcopter camera drone; violet spherical security drone with cyan eye and two fins. In each character's FIRST ROW: first five frames WALK/MOVE UP (north, back visible, visor facing away), then next five frames WALK/MOVE RIGHT (east). In its SECOND ROW: first five frames WALK/MOVE DOWN (south, face/visor visible), then next five frames WALK/MOVE LEFT (west). Therefore rows1-2 service robot, rows3-4 mech, rows5-6 spider drone, rows7-8 quadcopter, rows9-10 hover orb. All directions clearly different, not all facing camera. Motion includes leg stepping, visible rotor rotations, fin tilting and changing exhaust; same body size and center throughout each 5-frame sequence. Crisp dark-navy outlines, clean silver/slate with sapphire, orange/gold, emerald, violet accents. Professional readable arcade pixel sprites. Each cell contains ONE COMPLETE robot or drone, no clipping or touching other cells.
